claims.summary: Tallo (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6637599, CC BY 4.0) holds stem_diameter_cm and height_m for 498,838 individual trees of 5,163 species, which is what the log-diameter vs log-height exponent test needs. claims.next_step: Pre-register the exponent fit on Tallo (filter height_outlier = N, within-species and pooled); for the Greenhill height-cap clause, obtain pine elastic modulus from a wood-handbook source and join to Tallo Pinus records.

Coverage of the earliest and latest ages varies entry by entry and the raw data must be parsed out of MATLAB files.

claims.summary: The geometric half of the claim (chromatin moving from the poles to a peripheral ring on the equatorial plane, and what happens when microtubule attachment is perturbed) is testable from Zenodo 5551168, a CC BY 4.0 set of 3D kinetochore tracks in human RPE1 cells from prometaphase to anaphase with nocodazole and Aurora-B-inhibitor conditions, backed by IDR MitoCheck movies (CC0) and the idr0041 mitotic atlas; no archive holds magnetic susceptibility of mitotic chromatin or chromosome motion in an applied field, so the literal diamagnetic reading has no data.
claims.next_step: Pre-register, on the 5551168 tracks, the radial and axial position of kinetochores relative to the inferred spindle axis over time and the equatorial-ring geometry at metaphase, and compare untreated with nocodazole-release conditions; treat the diamagnetic mechanism as the analogy Thompson states it to be.

claims.summary: NHANES Body Measures files (BMXHT standing height, with RIDAGEYR age in DEMO) are openly downloadable as SAS transport files for every 2-year cycle since 1999 and give measured adult stature by age, but cross-sectionally and with age top-coded at 80, so they mix shrinkage with secular trend and cannot reach 'extreme old age'. HRS, the one longitudinal source named, returned 403 to curl and needs registration. No repository dataset of repeated measured heights in the same adults was found in DataCite, Zenodo or Dryad.
claims.next_step: Pre-register a cross-sectional NHANES test (pooled 1999–2018 BMXHT by RIDAGEYR, 20–80, sex-stratified) as a first pass; for the timing claim register for HRS or a European panel (ELSA/SHARE) to get within-person height change across waves.
